facts.fact: UNDP reports that under its EU-financed stabilisation programme civil registration registers were distributed to several communes of the Ouham to strengthen local registration, and a batch of registers for declaring births went to the maternity of Bossangoa university hospital; computer equipment and training in digitising civil registration documents are named as the next step, not yet delivered. The article does not date the distribution; the date is its publication date.
